primitives.name: Command Execution Readiness
primitives.verbatim_quote: When the command is given each man should be ready instantly to start doing his work.
primitives.assumptions: Readiness is binary: either fully prepared or not; execution begins at t_e = 0.
primitives.breakdown_regime: R_i < 1 implies delayed or incomplete activation.

layer2.mapping: Readiness kernel defines activation threshold for each player's role in GSE.
layer2.telemetry: Proportion of players achieving R_i = 1 within t_e = 0.1s.

primitives.name: Quarterly Signal Origin
primitives.verbatim_quote: Since the quarter must start every play, it is best that it originate in his own mind and be signalled to the rest of the team by him and by no one else.
primitives.assumptions: Quarter acts as central controller; signal integrity depends on single-point origin.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Q ≠ P indicates signal corruption or misdirection.

layer2.mapping: Quarter's mental model maps to GSE's initial state vector; GSI evaluates consistency of signal flow.
layer2.telemetry: Signal coherence index between quarter’s intent and team execution.
